name: Summoned Hound
text: As an additional cost to play Summoned Hound, you must search your bonded cards for 1 copy of Unbound Beast and shuffle it into your deck. [fast] During your turn, except during an action, exhaust Summoned Hound: Fight/Investigate. Either attack with a base [combat] skill of 5, or investigate with a base [intellect] skill of 5.
text_cn: 作为打出受召猎犬的额外费用，你必须在你的绑定卡牌中查找1张脱缰野兽，并将其混洗入你的牌堆。 [free]在你的回合中，除了行动中以外，消耗受召猎犬：攻击/调查。以基础值5点的[combat]技能攻击，或用基础值5点的[intellect]技能调查。
